Application Data.NAME: CleanWave Laundry Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanWave Laundry Services provides self-service and full-service laundry solutions, including wash-and-fold services, dry cleaning, and specialty stain removal. We cater to both residential and commercial clients, ensuring a clean, convenient, and efficient laundry experience. Our facility is equipped with modern, energy-efficient machines and offers a comfortable waiting area with complimentary Wi-Fi. We prioritize customer satisfaction and adhere to strict cleanliness and safety standards.
